name: polynomial-root-analysis
description: Polynomial Root Analysis — one polynomial and what acts on its roots. Roots and coefficients as two draggable point sets over a phase portrait (Vieta one way, a tracked re-solve the other), with certified Smith inclusion discs; the Galois group over ℚ in three honest tiers (= Sₙ/Aₙ at any degree, = to degree 7 by resolvents, ≈ 8–15 by statistics); loop monodromy by certified continuation, refused by name where a segment cannot be certified; and Arnold's topological proof of Abel–Ruffini as executed commutator loops. Established by ADR-0047 (plan: docs/polynomial-root-analysis/PLAN.md). Not ADR-0046's Polynomial Roots, the root-cloud renderer. Built on @cas/core (roots, polish), @cas/exact (exact parsing, Smith discs, Yun), @cas/expr (the parser), @cas/gpu (the phase portrait, CET-C6), @cas/rigor (the labels), @cas/interchange (#vs= permalinks), @cas/export (PNG metadata) and @cas/ui (shell, keyed builder); the new @cas/monodromy joins at PRA-3 (ADR-0007).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
